title: Getting pretty severe TPS when installed on server
correction_note: This analysis was initially based on NOT_FOUND status due to failure to locate files from commit ac67026. Files have now been extracted and analyzed. This is the CORRECTED analysis with actual log and config data.

server_log_analysis.findings: Log shows DH loading successfully but with significant WARN messages. The absence of explicit TPS warnings doesn't contradict the issue - TPS lag may not always trigger 'Can't keep up' messages if the server is managing to complete ticks but taking longer than optimal.

config_analysis.note: 806 lines - AGGRESSIVE settings identified that contribute to server lag. CRITICAL: showUpdateQueueOverloadedChatWarning = false means queue overload warnings are suppressed

critical_settings.risk: CRITICAL - 4096 block radius generation is EXTREMELY aggressive
CRITICAL - Synchronizing 4096 blocks causes massive server load
HIGH - 256 chunks = 4096 blocks of real-time updates
MEDIUM - 8 threads on a 20-thread server leaves limited headroom
MEDIUM - 20 requests/second per client adds up with multiple players
FEATURE - Required for DH functionality but causes server load
MEDIUM - SURFACE mode generates terrain features outside render distance
CRITICAL - Queue overload warnings are SUPPRESSED. MrFuzzihead won't see in-game warnings about queue buildup.
CRITICAL - Value 0 means generation bounds are DISABLED. No geographic limit on LOD generation. Work area expands indefinitely.
CRITICAL - BLOCK = 256 LODs per chunk (HIGHEST). CHUNK = 1 LOD per chunk. This is a 256x multiplier on processing work. Combined with 52.7M blocks² = ~13.5 BILLION LOD units per player.
CRITICAL - All 8 threads run at 100% capacity with ZERO idle time. At 0.5, CPU usage would halve without changing thread count.
HIGH - Z_STD: read 9.31ms, write 15.13ms per DTO. LZ4: read 3.25ms, write 5.99ms. Z_STD is ~3x slower on reads, ~2.5x slower on writes. Compounds with millions of blocks.
HIGH - Real-time LOD updates continuously push to clients as chunks change. Adds processing load on top of generation and sync.
MEDIUM - When enabled, allows loading lower detail levels to speed up terrain generation. Could reduce generation load. Disabled = missing optimization.
INFO - F3 screen shows queued chunk update count. MrFuzzihead has this enabled but hasn't been told to monitor it. Would show queue buildup in real-time.

config_analysis.root_cause: MrFuzzihead's config has EVERY knob cranked to MAXIMUM simultaneously: (1) Distance: 4096 blocks with generationBoundsRadius=0 (no geographic limit), (2) Resolution: maxHorizontalResolution='BLOCK' (256 LODs per chunk = 256x multiplier), (3) Threads: 8 at threadRunTimeRatio='1.0' (100% CPU, no idle), (4) Compression: Z_STD (3x slower I/O than LZ4), (5) Queue warnings: disabled. The COMPOUND EFFECT: 52.7M blocks² × 256 LODs/chunk = ~13.5 BILLION LOD units per player. Combined with 15ms tick budget, this creates catastrophic TPS lag.

findings.summary: Server TPS lag is caused by a COMPOUND EFFECT of EVERY setting cranked to MAXIMUM: (1) ForgeServerProxy.serverTickEvent() with unbounded queue and 15ms budget, (2) 4096-block distances with NO geographic bounds (generationBoundsRadius=0), (3) BLOCK resolution (256 LODs/chunk = 256x multiplier), (4) 8 threads at 100% CPU (threadRunTimeRatio=1.0), (5) Z_STD compression (3x slower I/O), (6) Queue warnings disabled. The actual processing volume is ~13.5 BILLION LOD units per player (52.7M blocks² × 256 LODs/chunk). With 20 threads/16GB, the server is overwhelmed by the combinatorial explosion of settings.
findings.root_cause: COMPOUND EFFECT: MrFuzzihead's config has EVERY setting at MAXIMUM simultaneously. Distance (4096 blocks) × Resolution (256 LODs/chunk) × Threads (8 @ 100%) × No bounds (generationBoundsRadius=0) = ~13.5 BILLION LOD units per player. The 15ms tick budget cannot handle this combinatorial explosion. Issue #50 (slow rate limiting) may also contribute to queue buildup.

primary.issue: 15ms time budget + unbounded chunk event queue + mandatory task execution

config_issues.issue: All distance settings at 4096 blocks (EXTREME values)

immediate_config_changes: numberOfThreads: 8 -> 4 (leave more CPU for other mods)
proposed_fix.code_fix: Reduce ForgeServerProxy.java time budget from 15ms to 5ms and add chunk event limit per tick

immediate: OR disable distant generation: enableDistantGeneration = false
profiling: Use /spark profiler --thread Server Thread to verify fix

falsification_test.description: If TPS issues persist after reducing config distances to 1024 and threads to 4, then the root cause is NOT the config settings but in the code (ForgeServerProxy tick handler).
steps: 1. Apply config changes: maxGenerationRequestDistance = 1024, maxSyncOnLoadRequestDistance = 1024, realTimeUpdateDistanceRadiusInChunks = 64, numberOfThreads = 4
2. Restart server and profile with /spark profiler --thread Server Thread for 60 seconds
3. Check if TPS stabilizes at 20 and serverTickEvent time drops
4. If lag persists: Root cause is in ForgeServerProxy code (15ms budget, unbounded queue)
5. If lag resolves: Root cause was the aggressive config settings
falsification_test.expected_result: TPS should improve significantly with config changes alone, confirming config as primary cause
